name: Soseki
q: Reckless by nature, I've always lost out
Everyone wants to believe they're the exception
I only wanted to be an honest man
I'll live on the word: loneliness
Those without will to grow are fools
However you look, the world is hard to live in
Live by reason, you clash; by feeling, you drift
I was born carrying loneliness itself
I am a cat. I have no name yet
Wait a hundred years. I will come.
We pay for freedom with loneliness
Climbing the mountain path, I thought to myself
I had a dream like this
Remember — I am a man who has lived like this
